n337879f684.headline: With a value of 866 million dirhams.. Dana Gas sells its onshore assets in Egypt
n337879f684.summary: Dana Gas concluded a binding agreement to sell its onshore oil and gas producing assets in Egypt for 866 million dirhams to IPR Al Wastani Petroleum Limited.
n337879f684.why: Asset sales by energy companies affect production capacity and capital allocation, influencing regional energy markets and company valuations.
